description_en: Initiates outbound robocall tasks in a batch. You can set up to 100 numbers in a task
description_zh: 批量发起智能语音机器人外呼任务，一次任务支持设置1~100个号码
kebab_example: aliyun dyvmsapi batch-robot-smart-call --called-show-number 13600000000,13800000000 --called-number 13900000000 --dialog-id 1000029700000 --task-name '批量外呼任务' --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchRobotSmartCall

parameters.help_en:
The number displayed to called parties, which must be a number you purchased. You can view the numbers you purchased in the Voice Messaging Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/dyvms.htm#/number/normal).

You can set up to 100 numbers and separate the numbers with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
被叫显号，必须是已购买的号码。您可以在语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/number/list/normal)查看已购买的号码。

支持设置1~100个被叫显号，号码之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: called_show_number

parameters.example: 阿里巴巴通信技术（北京）有限公司
parameters.help_en:
The company name, which must be the same as the company name specified on the qualification management page (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/dyvms.htm#/corp/normal).

This parameter is optional if isSelfLine is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
公司名称，必须和资质管理页面 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/dyvms.htm#/corp/normal)中的公司名称完全一致。

如果开通了自有线路功能，即isSelfLine为true时，该参数为可选。反之则必须填写公司名称
parameters.name: corp_name

parameters.help_en:
The called number. Only mobile phone numbers in the Chinese mainland are supported.

You can set up to 1,000 called numbers and separate the numbers with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
被叫号码。仅支持中国大陆号码。

支持设置1~1000个被叫号码，号码之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: called_number

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the robot or communication script that is used to initiate a call.

You can obtain the communication script ID from the Communication script management (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/dyvms.htm#/smart-call/saas/robot/list) page
parameters.help_zh:
指定机器人ID，即话术ID。表示选择哪个机器人/话术发起呼叫。

请在话术管理页面 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/patter/list)中查看话术ID
parameters.name: dialog_id

parameters.help_en:
The speech recognition identifier of early media. The default value is false, which means that the speech recognition identifier of early media is not enabled.

Set the parameter to true if you want to enable the speech recognition identifier of early media
parameters.help_zh:
早媒体语音识别标识。默认为false，即不启用。

如果需要启用早媒体语音识别标识，请设置为true
parameters.name: early_media_asr

parameters.help_en: The task name. The task name can be up to 30 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
任务名称。

支持中文和英文。

长度限制为：0~30个字符
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en:
The preset call time. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

This parameter is required only when ScheduleCall is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
预设的呼叫时间。Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒。

当参数ScheduleCall为true时必选
parameters.name: schedule_time

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the call is scheduled. If you set this parameter to true, the ScheduleTime parameter is required
parameters.help_zh: 是否定时呼叫。如果设置为true，则必须设置ScheduleTime
parameters.name: schedule_call

parameters.help_en:
The variable value of the TTS template, in the JSON format.

The variable value must correspond to a number. The TtsParam parameter must be used together with the TtsParamHead parameter
parameters.help_zh:
TTS模板的变量值，格式为JSON。

必须和具体的号码对应，TtsParam与TtsParamHead变量名称一一对应
parameters.name: tts_param

parameters.help_en:
The call tasks with variables, in the JSON format.

The parameter value is a list of variable names. The TtsParamHead parameter must be used together with the TtsParam parameter
parameters.help_zh:
带变量的呼叫任务，格式为JSON。

变量名称列表，与TtsParam配合使用
parameters.name: tts_param_head

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to call the self-managed line. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否调用自有线路，默认为false，即不调用
parameters.name: is_self_line

Code.description_en:
The response code.

The value OK indicates that the request was successful.
For more information about other response codes, see [API error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码详见[API错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）

TaskId.description_en: The unique ID of the robocall task. You can call the [QueryCallDetailByTaskId]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/393537.html） operation to query the details of the task based on the task ID
TaskId.description_zh: 机器人呼叫任务的唯一任务ID，可以通过此ID调用[QueryCallDetailByTaskId]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/393537.html）接口查询任务详情
